description: First time participating and my plan for this challenge entails yielding both a virtual and a tangible product which introduces young space enthusiasts to NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. The main aim is to create, learn and simply have fun with individuals who are passionate about space & spacecraft. We are here to have a good time!
summary: For the Abandoned but Not Forgotten challenge I developed a physical model of the Lunar Trailblazer - a satellite that was meant to complete a lunar mission, but failed due to software errors, now is lost in deep space. Through physical learning young space enthusiasts can learn more about the engineering of this spacecraft, why it failed, what we learned from it.
details: It is a cardboard model of the lunar Trailblazer with movable and rotating features, working LEDs to make the most immersive learning experience for young space enthusiasts. It is important because it talks about a recent mission of a spacecraft that lost contact with Earth immediately. Youngsters can learn about the engineering that made this satellite function, what was its purpose and what we learnt from its experience.
